messages:
Maya: Heads-up — ran a lightweight t-test style sanity check on the new 3B Q4H3 variant over a 2k sample (mixed longform & chat). Wanted to share numbers and get quick ops/product guidance before we consider canary routing. @Devon @Helena
Devon: nice, high level numbers?
Maya: summary: mean ROUGE-like fidelity delta = -0.9 pts (model->quant), p-value ~ 0.04 (paired), Cohen's d ~ 0.22. Latency + tail: median +9ms, p95 +28ms. Token cost per request dropped ~38%.
Samir: is the -0.9 pts concentrated on a slice?
Maya: yes — mostly on factuality in the longform summarization slice and a small drop on multi-step chains. Conversational prompts and single-turn QA look flat.
Helena: sample size 2k — what's the variance across prompts? any outliers?
Maya: variance higher in longform (std dev ~1.8) vs chat (std dev ~0.6). I ran a quick bootstrap CI and the lower bound on fidelity delta for chat includes 0. For longform delta CI = [-1.6, -0.2].
Devon: unit econ numbers? how much $/k tokens saved?
Maya: ballpark: before (fp16/int8 mix) unit cost ~ $0.48 per 1k tokens rendered; q4h3 candidate ~ $0.30 per 1k tokens. So ~38% per-token cost reduction. For our average request length that maps to ~$0.002 saved per request.
Samir: small per-request but at scale this is meaningful. What's expected end-user impact?
Maya: for conversational UX around 90% of calls are fine. The risky 10% are longform summarizers used in product X where fidelity matters.
Helena: can we do hybrid routing by prompt classifier? e.g., route longform to fallback int8, otherwise q4h3
Maya: yep — tested a cheap heuristic classifier: accuracy ~92% on held-out labels. Implemented prototype routing with negligible overhead.
Devon: ops question — memory regens or kvcache issues with q4h3?
Maya: kvcache size stable. Memory per replica dropped ~12%, so we can fit more replicas per GPU which drives the cost saving. No regressions observed in telemetry except slightly higher p95.
Samir: what's the recommended rollout plan? small canary? slice gating?
Maya: proposal: 1) shadow for 24h with metric hooks (fidelity, hallucination checks, latency tail) 2) 5% canary with routing: default->q4h3, longform->int8 3) monitor evaluation set and online QA signals for regressions, if fidelity drop >1.2 pts then rollback.
Helena: add a targeted eval for the longform summarizer prompts every 15 minutes during canary. Also record raw outputs for quick manual spot checks.
Devon: agree. add cost dashboard plumbing to console (per-route cost per 1k tokens) and an alert if unit cost moves outside expected band after rollout.
Maya: I'll open a small runbook and PR for the routing flag. Quick code snippet for how the routing will look in prod:```json
{"route_rules": [{"matcher": "prompt_tags contains 'longform'", "model": "3b-int8"}, {"matcher": "default", "model": "3b-q4h3"}]}```
Samir: great. one more ask — can we do a small A/B with user-facing metric (engagement/time-to-first-edit) in the product sandbox?
Devon: product ok with a lightweight A/B at 5% if ops + ml guardrails are in place.
ops-bot: canary deployment scheduled: queueing canary job (id: ck-2026-17550). Notify channel when canary starts.
Maya: I'll push the shadow run now and follow up with the runbook link. Will post signal snapshots at T+1h and T+24h. :thumbsup:
Helena: thanks — tagging data infra to save the eval snapshots to S3 for reproducibility.
Samir: thanks team. If signals look good we can flip the routing and capture cost savings incrementally.
Maya: closing loop — shadow job started at 1755000005. Will post interim numbers shortly.
ops-bot: canary started at 1755000100 (ck-2026-17550). Monitor: fidelity_check / latency_tail / cost_delta.
